$comment: Buscas salvas no PubMed para o módulo literatura (modules/literatura). Cada busca roda a cada execução sobre os registros que entraram no PubMed nos últimos `days` dias; cada artigo é tratado uma vez. Sintaxe do PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/help/. Para testar uma busca, cole o `term` no site do PubMed. perRun limita quantos artigos novos são escritos por execução (a cada 6 horas); languages filtra pelo idioma do artigo.

queries.name: Estenose subglótica e traqueal; reconstrução
queries.term: ("Laryngostenosis"[Mesh] OR "Tracheal Stenosis"[Mesh] OR "subglottic stenosis"[tiab] OR "tracheal stenosis"[tiab] OR "laryngotracheal stenosis"[tiab] OR "laryngotracheal reconstruction"[tiab] OR laryngotracheoplasty[tiab] OR "cricotracheal resection"[tiab] OR "slide tracheoplasty"[tiab] OR "tracheal resection"[tiab] OR "idiopathic subglottic stenosis"[tiab]) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Traqueostomia e decanulação em crianças
queries.term: (("Tracheostomy"[Mesh] OR tracheostom*[tiab] OR tracheotom*[tiab] OR decannulation[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Malácias, pregas vocais, fenda laríngea e papilomatose
queries.term: ("Laryngomalacia"[Mesh] OR "Tracheomalacia"[Mesh] OR "Tracheobronchomalacia"[Mesh] OR laryngomalacia[tiab] OR tracheomalacia[tiab] OR tracheobronchomalacia[tiab] OR aortopexy[tiab] OR tracheopexy[tiab] OR supraglottoplasty[tiab] OR "laryngeal cleft"[tiab] OR "recurrent respiratory papillomatosis"[tiab] OR (("Vocal Cord Paralysis"[Mesh] OR "vocal fold paralysis"[tiab] OR "vocal cord paralysis"[tiab] OR "vocal fold immobility"[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh]))) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Corpo estranho na via aérea
queries.term: (("Foreign Bodies"[Mesh] OR "foreign body"[tiab] OR "foreign bodies"[tiab]) AND (aspiration[tiab] OR airway*[tiab] OR bronch*[tiab] OR trachea*[tiab])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Atresia de esôfago e fístula traqueoesofágica
queries.term: ("Tracheoesophageal Fistula"[Mesh] OR "tracheoesophageal fistula"[tiab] OR "tracheo-esophageal fistula"[tiab] OR "Esophageal Atresia"[Mesh] OR "esophageal atresia"[tiab] OR "oesophageal atresia"[tiab]) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Broncoscopia e via aérea intervencionista em crianças
queries.term: (("Bronchoscopy"[Mesh] OR bronchoscop*[tiab] OR "airway endoscopy"[tiab] OR "airway stent"[tiab] OR "airway stents"[tiab] OR "balloon dilation"[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Via aérea intervencionista do adulto
queries.term: ("rigid bronchoscopy"[tiab] OR "airway stent"[tiab] OR "airway stents"[tiab] OR "central airway obstruction"[tiab] OR "tracheobronchial stent"[tiab] OR "post-intubation tracheal stenosis"[tiab] OR "postintubation tracheal stenosis"[tiab] OR "tracheal injury"[tiab] OR "tracheobronchial injury"[tiab]) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Lesão de via aérea por intubação em neonatos e crianças
queries.term: ((intubation[tiab] OR extubation[tiab] OR "endotracheal tube"[tiab]) AND (subglottic[tiab] OR laryngeal[tiab] OR "airway injury"[tiab] OR stridor[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Malformações pulmonares congênitas
queries.term: ("Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation of Lung, Congenital"[Mesh] OR "Bronchopulmonary Sequestration"[Mesh] OR CPAM[tiab] OR CCAM[tiab] OR "congenital pulmonary airway malformation"[tiab] OR "congenital lung malformation"[tiab] OR "congenital lung malformations"[tiab] OR "pulmonary sequestration"[tiab] OR "congenital lobar emphysema"[tiab] OR "congenital lobar overinflation"[tiab] OR "bronchogenic cyst"[tiab]) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Hérnia diafragmática congênita
queries.term: ("Hernias, Diaphragmatic, Congenital"[Mesh] OR "congenital diaphragmatic hernia"[tiab]) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Deformidades da parede torácica
queries.term: ("Funnel Chest"[Mesh] OR "Pectus Carinatum"[Mesh] OR "pectus excavatum"[tiab] OR "pectus carinatum"[tiab] OR "Nuss procedure"[tiab] OR "chest wall deformity"[tiab] OR "chest wall deformities"[tiab]) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Empiema, pneumonia necrotizante e pneumotórax em crianças
queries.term: (("Empyema, Pleural"[Mesh] OR empyema[tiab] OR "parapneumonic effusion"[tiab] OR "necrotizing pneumonia"[tiab] OR "necrotising pneumonia"[tiab] OR pneumothorax[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Toracoscopia, tumores e ressecções pulmonares em crianças
queries.term: ((thoracoscop*[tiab] OR "Thoracic Surgery, Video-Assisted"[Mesh] OR "thoracic surgery"[tiab] OR "robotic thoracic"[tiab] OR "mediastinal mass"[tiab] OR "mediastinal tumor"[tiab] OR "mediastinal tumour"[tiab] OR "lung resection"[tiab] OR lobectomy[tiab] OR "chest wall tumor"[tiab] OR "chest wall tumour"[tiab] OR "pleuropulmonary blastoma"[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Fibrose cística, bronquiectasias e discinesia ciliar com interface cirúrgica ou endoscópica
queries.term: (("cystic fibrosis"[tiab] OR bronchiectasis[tiab] OR "primary ciliary dyskinesia"[tiab]) AND (bronchoscop*[tiab] OR "lung transplant"[tiab] OR "lung transplantation"[tiab] OR hemoptysis[tiab] OR lobectomy[tiab] OR "lung resection"[tiab] OR pneumothorax[tiab])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Displasia broncopulmonar, ventilação prolongada e via aérea
queries.term: (("bronchopulmonary dysplasia"[tiab] OR "chronic ventilation"[tiab] OR "home ventilation"[tiab] OR "prolonged ventilation"[tiab]) AND (tracheostom*[tiab] OR airway*[tiab] OR bronchoscop*[tiab] OR tracheomalacia[tiab]) AND (child*[tiab] OR infant*[tiab] OR pediatric[tiab] OR paediatric[tiab] OR neonat*[tiab] OR newborn*[tiab] OR adolescen*[tiab] OR "Child"[Mesh] OR "Infant"[Mesh])) NOT "Published Erratum"[pt]

queries.name: Transplante pulmonar pediátrico
